criteria.label: Innovation & Operational Utility
criteria.reason: HealthIA now goes beyond adaptive conversation. A typed health or scheduled event can autonomously open a mission, request a bounded next piece of evidence, receive a later event, create a persistent artifact and reach a verified completed state. The scheduled consultation preparation path also completes useful work without a patient chat prompt. Hosted CI proves the workflow semantics and browser trace; the remaining utility gap is live Google Cloud execution with real ADK/Gemini evidence.

criteria.label: Architectural Discipline & Tech Stack
criteria.reason: The architecture now separates event dispatch, deterministic safety, Google ADK decisioning, bounded deterministic mission tools, durable state, public operational traces and cost control. Pub/Sub authenticated push, dedicated service accounts, Secret Manager, Firestore, Cloud Run scale-to-zero and a paused Scheduler are encoded in reproducible deployment scripts. ADK cannot downgrade the deterministic safety oracle and the full two-call model budget is reserved atomically before execution. The remaining deductions are for live infrastructure proof and production-grade authenticated multi-patient isolation outside the hackathon demo boundary.

criteria.label: Demo & Production Readiness
criteria.reason: The hosted verification now installs the production dependencies and Chromium, passes the complete Python suite, verifies fifteen full-system workflows, renders two adaptive clinical blocks plus a judge-visible autonomous closure trace, parses all PowerShell launchers, builds the release archive and reruns tests from the extracted ZIP. Architecture, cloud-proof procedure and a timed four-minute demo script are assembled. The major remaining deduction is deliberate: there is still no retained real Google Cloud proof and no final unedited demo video.
